SOFTWARE LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Software License Agreement ("Agreement") is effective as of March 1, 2025 through March 1, 2026, between IslandSoft Ltd. ("Vendor") and Acme Global Corp. ("Customer").

1. ANNUAL LICENSE FEE
Annual license fee: $80,000.00 USD.

2. LIABILITY CAP
Maximum total liability is capped at $120,000.00 USD.

3. RENEWAL AND TERMINATION
No automatic renewal applies. Termination for convenience requires 45 days prior written notice.

4. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Cayman Islands (KY-CAYMAN).
